{{Quote|What do you think our Sep chums want, Derel?"<br />"Given that ''Discord'' is within her firing range, sir, I'd say they want us in one piece.|Gilad Pellaeon and Derel|<ref name="NoPrisoners" />}}
'''Derel''' was a [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officer]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Holding the rank of [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], he served as a principal warfare officer of ''[[Leveler]]'', under command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. Pellaeon commented that he wished all the bridge posts on his ship were manned by clones such as Derel. Derel was stationed aboard the ''Leveler'' during the [[Battle of JanFathal|engagement]] with the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist fleet]] over [[JanFathal]].
